definitions: A census-designated place in Marin County, California, United States.

blocks.text: The musical term alto, meaning "high" in Italian, historically refers to the contrapuntal part higher than the tenor and its associated vocal range. In four-part voice leading alto is the second-highest part, sung in choruses by either low women's or high men's voices. In vocal classification these are usually called mezzo-soprano, contralto and male alto or countertenor.

Alto is a planned high-speed rail line in Canada, intended to connect major cities including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal, and Quebec City. The planning and development of the line is being overseen by a federal Crown corporation operating under the same name which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Via Rail Canada Inc.
